findings.note: Sponsor of SB 29, which would require voters to give a photocopy of a photo ID (driver's license, passport or other valid ID card) when applying for an absentee ballot and again when returning it, in place of the current signature-match check. Capitol Beat dated its story 2021-01-28 and said the bill was filed the Tuesday before; another outlet said Wednesday, so only the month is given.
